caseName: United States ex rel. Billerman v. Long
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. George W. Billerman v. Matthew J. Long, Criminal Sheriff of the Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Louisiana.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. Winans Wall and Mr. Robert H. Marr for appellant. Mr. Thomas Lee Woolwine for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Empire State-Idaho Mining Co. v. Hanley, 205 U. S. 225, 232; Goodrich v. Ferris, 214 U. S. 71, 79; Brolan v. United States, 236 U. S. 216, 218.
